.skill-tree/common/references/director-w: ## Interpret one branch report

Select the exact plan revision, assignment, criterion, producer and consumer revisions, attempt and actual environment. Compare expected and observed scope and digests before interpreting the result. Separate required and supplementary checks, missing cases and later steps left unexecuted. Name the earliest evidenced divergence and the observation needed to distinguish a prerequisite from a discrepancy.

A mismatched canon pin returns to Narrative, a replaced ArtWorkshop input to 3D, and a receiver binding or effective value mismatch to Unity. Game Design owns an unresolved rule or experience choice. Request human evidence when the selected question concerns a person's response. Creative acceptance requires the actual author decision. An unavailable environment or unsupported format leaves verification open.

Match redelivery by exact observation identity and digest. Keep a distinct new attempt and earlier result. A changed digest under the same identity or expired source holds current verification. An unaffected sibling keeps matching evidence and the original acceptance remains readable.
## Present a playable decision after repair

Route an accepted-rule discrepancy to the area that owns the first mismatching fact, rule, cue, asset or runtime binding. After repair pin current revisions and rerun the affected checks and one independent control. Retain the technical lane, actual result and uncovered cases.

Use the selected supported build or scene and exact entry state for a human observation. Record the first uncoached choice and any later facilitation. Separate an unclear goal, missed route and failed control by evidence. Present the author with the playable entry point, observed result, remaining scope and one precise decision. Technical results establish observable behavior in the recorded lane. Creative acceptance requires the actual author response on the current presented revision. Reopen the affected criterion when a new technical or usability finding changes the basis.
## Measure comparable design work

Freeze the decision and eligible population before counting. Keep stable request, revision, handoff, evidence and attempt identities. Compare equivalent scope, clock and source availability. Count identical delivery once. Preserve new attempts under the original request and report excluded and unmeasured cases with reasons. An empty eligible denominator yields no estimate.
| Decision | Calculation and evidence |

| Is the GDD sufficient for independent predictions? | Accepted rule revisions with both normal and boundary outcomes predicted correctly by an independent reader divided by sampled accepted rule revisions with both known expected outcomes. Cite the accepted rule and independent check. Report missing expected outcomes separately from absent predictions against a known oracle. |

| Are the recommendations applicable? | Applicable recommendations divided by independently judged original slots within a frozen K and held-out request scope. Count identical delivery once. Count the first occurrence of a repeated suggestion and keep the original later rank as a repeat. Report no-fit, empty and unjudged results separately. Cite the ranked suggestion and independent judgement. |

| Did the atlas find affected placements? | Known affected placements omitted from the report divided by the confirmed affected set in the audited scope. Pair the exact placement record and independent audit. Keep suspected links and unexamined regions separate. |

| Does impact review reopen too much? | Confirmed unnecessary rechecks divided by all distinct proposed rechecks in the selected scope. Cite each proposed recheck and the independent verdict for the same dependency. Report unresolved verdicts alongside the count. |

| Can a Balance result be reproduced? | Studies reproduced within the declared tolerance by an independent reviewer divided by reviewed studies with sufficient matching inputs. Record the study version, selected comparison, units, assumptions and separate count of insufficient inputs. Retain retries as attempts within the study and pin the comparison evidence. |

| How well did the tuning forecast match? | Measured change minus the change predicted before observation for the same parameter, conditions, units and clock. Record matched denominators when applicable, effective setting, direction and any adverse outcome separately. Use the study and matching evidence record. An unmeasured forecast stays unscored. |

| How long until usable evidence? | Median elapsed UTC time from input readiness to first adequate evidence for comparable completed requests with both timestamps. Record incomplete work or missing timestamps, environment and author waits, wrong routes and insufficient data from the request and evidence receipts. |

| How often does a handoff return? | Distinct reviewed handoffs returned at least once for a confirmed description fault divided by all distinct reviewed handoffs in the named cohort. Keep reasons such as an unavailable environment, authorization wait or other return separate. Use the reviewed handoff and return receipts. Retain actual revisions and later attempts. |

Store compact local inputs and evidence IDs so a second reader can recompute each measure. Standalone documents may use local project identities without a Director run. Follow [compact evidence retention](history-retention.md) for locators, gaps and original outcomes.
## Compare ordinary and revised handoffs

Freeze equivalent briefs, accepted facts, available inputs, controls, and exact ordinary and revised instruction revisions. Ask two independent reviewers to reconstruct expected and consumed revisions, coverage, earliest evidenced divergence and next owner. Record reviewer disagreement and unavailable evidence. An unavailable decisive input leaves causal attribution open. Record the missing evidence and the responsible owner.

Check changed intent, effective configuration, available artifacts and author waits before assigning a recurring problem to a skill. A skill finding requires reproduction under a known instruction revision and an independently established outcome. Record adopt, revise or defer for the selected scope with residual uncertainty. Recheck the original case, an unaffected negative control and a comparable new request after an authorized fix.
## Review selected branch reports

Select the exact plan revision, assignment, criterion, producer and consumer revisions, attempt, actual environment and read-only artifact references. Verify the supported report format, required inputs and digests. Compare the required case set with the cases reached and reported. Keep supplementary observations in the report with separate coverage. Record the expected and observed result, earliest established divergence, missing and unreached steps, next owner and the evidence needed. Leave current verification open when the selected revision, format or evidence is unavailable.
| Selected finding | Next owner and action |
| A route passes on foreign canon or a replaced accepted Narrative source | Narrative resolves the selected work and accepted source, then replays affected routes on that input. |
| An accepted ArtWorkshop stage used a replaced predecessor | The 3D stage owner reconciles the earliest stale input and rechecks affected candidates. |
| A current imported asset has a wrong effective value, writer or runtime binding | Unity inspects the selected object, actual environment and first differing input or write. |
| A gameplay rule or tuning change requires a design decision | Game Design and the designated rule owner compare scoped alternatives. |
| The result raises a question about comprehension, response or enjoyment | The observation owner proposes a suitable human attempt. An author decision covers the selected creative result. |
| The required target or evidence is unavailable | The responsible area supplies the named prerequisite. The report records an open verification rather than a measured discrepancy. |

An exact redelivery keeps one observation. A new attempt adds a separate result with the same criterion where applicable. Conflicting bytes under one identity, expired evidence and unsupported formats leave current verification open while original observations remain visible. Keep an unaffected sibling eligible when the criterion and consumed sources still match. Apply an accepted review or scope change through the existing guarded procedures and retain original source and plan references.
## Review repair and prepare human acceptance

Find the first divergence from an accepted fact, gameplay rule, visible asset or effective binding. Return the exact discrepancy to the area responsible for the first mismatch. Current technical recheck records the selected target, new producer and consumer revisions, affected cases, observed input and result, unchanged control and remaining coverage. Preserve earlier evidence and the missing steps that require a fresh attempt.

Use the existing human observation procedure to present the supported build, scene entry, starting state, control and clock. Record the participant's first choice before intervention, stated expectation and relevant cue. Record the time and content of coaching and label the later observation. A known-route execution can establish reachability. Unaided discovery needs the selected relevant participant observation.
| Observation | First check to distinguish the cause |
| The participant reports an unclear goal | Compare intended fact, delivered wording and the visible or audible cue before attributing meaning to Narrative, UI or integration. |
| The goal is clear and the route was missed | Inspect the first choice and camera or affordance cue. Use a known-route control to distinguish discoverability from blocked traversal. |
| The participant intended and tried an action that had no effect | Inspect ordinary input, current binding, guard and first state writer under the selected build conditions. |

Return the playable entry point, current revisions, observed behavior, affected and unobserved scope, and one precise creative decision. Only the actual author's scoped response records creative acceptance. A technical pass can make the presentation eligible. Reopen the specific claim when a new technical or usability finding changes the evidence or the scope presented to the author.
## Locate the first divergence in comparable handoffs

Choose an ordinary and revised handoff under equivalent request, authorized scope, accepted facts and deliverable. Freeze both instruction revisions, actual available inputs, expected and consumed source pins and independent outcome criteria. Record differing conditions as comparison limits. Give the same compact records and controls to two separate reviewers. Ask each reviewer to reconstruct pins, coverage, earliest known discrepancy and next owner without the other review.

Compare owner, affected step, missing evidence and unaffected control. Preserve disagreement and the evidence that could resolve the disagreement. Trace accepted intent, selected configuration and bindings, available evidence and owner waits before assigning an instruction or product cause. Missing decisive input leaves causal attribution open. A skill-level finding requires reproduction on the identified instruction revision and an independent outcome for the same conditions.

Record adopt, revise or defer for an exact selected scope, known risk and residual uncertainty. An authorized fix rechecks the original case, an unaffected negative control and a new comparable request. A paper reconstruction qualifies the review procedure. Live comparative effectiveness requires matched project requests and reported actual results.

observation.observation: Verified the original three reciprocal impact cases against exact final Director contracts and current owned intake, plan and review reference copies. Additions preserve valid evidence, first established Unity divergence and precise author decisions. The accepted rule and existing evidence remain when an incompatible proposal is declined.

retained_cases.wording: Unconsumed label changes only. Compare exact received route, interaction, event and marker; retained narrow-scope route result is the independent control. A changed whole-document pin keeps conservative review. Existing intent supplies the outcome.
retained_cases.accepted: The adopted hand-to-belt marker and revised normal-gate timing are separate. 3D verifies the source marker, design verifies timing, Mechanics traces placement. Unity repairs the stale active hand binding and rechecks the exact imported belt and event. Training is suspected, far exit unexamined, and no-lift is the independent control. Only a material cost, scope or intent tradeoff now requires an author decision.
retained_cases.optional: Decline the unadopted conflicting action with the accepted scene fact. A compatible visible action remains a proposal. An author decision is needed for consequential added cost or scope or a change to accepted canon or experience.
